# vantage_tag (Resource)

Manages visibility and preference settings for a standard tag dimension.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "vantage_tag" "app" {
  tag_key   = "app"
  hidden    = false
  preferred = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `tag_key` (String) The standard tag key to manage.

### Optional

- `hidden` (Boolean) Whether the tag is hidden from the Vantage UI.
- `preferred` (Boolean) Whether the tag is marked as preferred in the Vantage UI.

### Read-Only

- `providers` (Set of String) Providers that expose the tag key.
